secrets.name: OMEGA_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /v1/attest (>=32 chars). A dev placeholder is provided in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real random key for trustworthy attestations.

secrets.name: OMEGA_LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible model key for ELION in POST /api/execute. Without it the endpoint answers with the clearly labelled local deterministic composer. Skipped on purpose — the local composer is the default path.

secrets.name: OMEGA_LLM_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional base URL for the OpenAI-compatible model endpoint used by ELION. Unset falls back to the built-in default. Not required to boot.

secrets.name: OMEGA_LLM_MODEL
secrets.description: Optional model name for ELION's external completion. Unset falls back to the built-in default. Not required to boot.
